purpose: Fallback prompts for Orpheus-TTS nonverbal emotion tags when verified movie subtitles do not provide enough clean local samples.

voice_style_boundary.allowed: young adult female, naturalistic, understated, slightly husky, dry close-mic performance
voice_style_boundary.not_allowed: do not claim or request a Kristen Stewart voice clone or deceptive celebrity impersonation
voice_style_boundary.provenance_rule: Generated SFX must be stored as source_type=sfx and must not be mixed into actor-specific movie evidence claims.

global_negative_prompt: no words, no music, no room tone, no crowd, no ambience, no reverb, no delay, no Foley objects, no background noise, no dialogue overlap
quality_checks: single nonverbal vocalization matches target tag
clean isolated audio with no music or dialogue
duration is short enough for tag insertion
write source_type=sfx and source_model/provider into watch_orpheus_segments
